description: Source code for a Kivy widget class 'VKeyboard', an on-screen keyboard supporting customizable layouts, multitouch, and different modes (docked and free). It includes methods for layout loading, rendering, and touch event handling.

classes.name: VKeyboard
classes.description: A customizable on-screen keyboard widget supporting multiple layouts, multitouch, and docked/free modes, built on top of Kivy's Scatter widget.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the VKeyboard, sets default properties, binds events, loads layouts, and prepares the widget for display.

methods.name: on_disabled
methods.description: Refreshes keys when the widget's disabled state changes.

methods.name: _update_layout_mode
methods.description: Updates the layout mode ('normal', 'shift', 'special') based on capslock and shift states.

methods.name: _load_layout
methods.description: Loads the current layout, either from a JSON file or from available layouts.

methods.name: _load_layouts
methods.description: Loads all JSON layout files from the specified layout path.

methods.name: _load_layout_fn
methods.description: Loads a specific layout JSON file and adds it to available layouts.

methods.name: setup_mode
methods.description: Configures the keyboard mode (docked or free) based on the 'docked' property.

methods.name: setup_mode_dock
methods.description: Sets the keyboard in docked mode, fixed to the bottom of the window.

methods.name: _update_dock_mode
methods.description: Adjusts scale and position when window size changes in docked mode.

methods.name: setup_mode_free
methods.description: Sets the keyboard in free mode, allowing user-controlled positioning.

methods.name: change_layout
methods.description: Placeholder for a method to change the keyboard layout via a popup.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recreates the widget's graphics and keys based on the current layout.

methods.name: refresh_active_keys_layer
methods.description: Updates the visual layer showing active (pressed) keys.

methods.name: refresh_keys_hint
methods.description: Calculates relative positions and sizes for keys based on layout and margins.

methods.name: refresh_keys
methods.description: Positions and draws all keys and background images according to layout.

methods.name: draw_keys
methods.description: Draws the background and labels for each key in the layout.

methods.name: on_key_down
methods.description: Placeholder for handling key down events.

methods.name: on_key_up
methods.description: Placeholder for handling key up events.

methods.name: on_textinput
methods.description: Placeholder for handling text input events.

methods.name: get_key_at_pos
methods.description: Returns the key data at a given (x, y) position within the widget.

methods.name: collide_margin
methods.description: Checks if a point is within the widget's margin area.

methods.name: process_key_on
methods.description: Handles a touch event when a key is pressed, updating states and dispatching events.

methods.name: process_key_up
methods.description: Handles a touch event when a key is released, updating states and dispatching events.

methods.name: _get_modifiers
methods.description: Returns a list of active modifier keys ('shift', 'capslock').

methods.name: _start_repeat_key
methods.description: Starts repeating a key when held down.

methods.name: _repeat_key
methods.description: Repeatedly processes the key being held down.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events, initiating key press if within bounds.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch release events, ending key press.
